title: 냉장고를 열었더니…: 해 보고 알게 된 것 말하기
objective: By the end, you can make the -았더니/-었더니/-했더니 forms of verbs and use them to say what you found out, or what result came, after your own action.
summary: Learn how to use -었더니 to say what you found or what happened after you did something.

task.title: Use -었더니 correctly
task.line: Make the right -었더니 form, choose the natural sentence, and answer in Korean.

forms.when: Stem's last vowel is ㅏ or ㅗ (가다 → 갔더니, 보다 → 봤더니)
forms.means: I did A, and then I found B or B resulted (discovery or result; the meaning comes from context, not from the form).
forms.exampleMeaning: I went to the market, and there were so many people.

forms.when: Any other vowel (먹다 → 먹었더니, 마시다 → 마셨더니)
forms.means: I did A, and then I found B or B resulted (discovery or result; the meaning comes from context, not from the form).
forms.example: 약을 먹었더니 이제 머리가 안 아파요.
forms.exampleMeaning: I took some medicine, and now my headache is gone.

forms.means: I did A, and then I found B / B happened.
forms.exampleMeaning: I called my friend, but he didn't answer.

forms.when: Some ㄷ verbs change ㄷ to ㄹ (걷다 → 걸었더니, 듣다 → 들었더니)
forms.means: Same meaning; only the stem changes.
forms.exampleMeaning: I walked a lot today, so my legs hurt.

watchOut: 동생이 냉장고를 열었더니 (X) → 제가 냉장고를 열었더니 (O): The person who does the first action is usually you, the speaker.
일찍 잤더니 내일 피곤하지 않을 거예요 (X) → 일찍 잤더니 오늘 피곤하지 않아요 (O): The second part tells what already happened or is true now. No future, no requests.
제가 그 약을 먹더니 (X) → 제가 그 약을 먹었더니 (O): For your own action, keep 았/었. -더니 without 었 is a different pattern.
exercises: Write the verb in brackets with -었더니: ① 창문을 (열다) ____ 시원한 바람이 들어왔어요. ② 저녁에 커피를 두 잔 (마시다) ____ 잠이 안 와요. ③ 선생님께 (질문하다) ____ 친절하게 설명해 주셨어요.
Write the verb in brackets with -었더니 (watch the stem): ① 이어폰으로 음악을 크게 (듣다) ____ 귀가 아파요. ② 밖을 (보다) ____ 눈이 오고 있었어요.
Choose the natural sentence, A or B: ① A. 어제 일찍 잤더니 오늘 몸이 가벼워요. / B. 어제 일찍 잤더니 내일 몸이 가벼울 거예요. ② A. 동생이 가방을 열었더니 지갑이 없었어요. / B. 제가 가방을 열었더니 지갑이 없었어요.
Choose the right word: 제가 매운 라면을 (먹더니 / 먹었더니) 배가 아파요.
Join the two sentences into one with -었더니: 세탁소에 갔어요. 문이 닫혀 있었어요.
Answer the question in Korean with -었더니, joining the two hints in order (first action → result): 얼굴이 좋아 보이네요. 무슨 일 있어요? (Hint: 요즘 매일 운동하다 → 잠을 잘 자다)
answers: ① 열었더니 ② 마셨더니 ③ 질문했더니
요즘 매일 운동했더니 잠을 잘 자요. (요즘 매일 운동했더니 잠을 잘 자게 됐어요.)
